examples.explanation: The 2x2 block of 1s in rows 1-2, columns 2-3 (0-based) has area 4.
No 2x2 all-1 square exists, but single 1s do, so the area is 1.

hints: Let dp[i][j] be the side of the biggest all-1 square ending at (i, j): it extends the squares above, to the left, and diagonally above-left.
On a '1', dp[i][j] = 1 + min of those three neighbours; on a '0' it is 0.
Track the largest side seen and return its square; a single row of state suffices.
title: 336. Maximal Square
